BEGINNING OF CONVERSATION: USER: Who is Stalin? ASSISTANT:

Joseph Stalin (1879-1953) was a Soviet leader who ruled the USSR from 1929 to 1953. He was one of the most influential figures of the 20th century and is remembered as one of the key figures in the rise of communism in the Soviet Union. He was also responsible for the deaths of millions of people in his purges of the 1930s.
